policy: A field has exactly one authoritative source. A reference joins to that source; it does not overwrite its fields. No last-writer-wins precedence.

project-registry.clarification: department_id here owns the project's assignment; the department source owns department identity/name/state

daily-activity.clarification: project_id here owns the activity's assignment; the registry owns project identity and descriptive fields

derived.row_ordinal: capture order starting at 1, excluding header
